about: Regulation values the lap simulator uses. scripts/sim/rule-params.mjs reads the newest matching official document, extracts each value with its pattern (the last number when a marked-up issue shows old and new values) and writes worker/lapsim/rules-data.js. A value outside its range is not applied; the previous one stays and the report flags it.

params.pattern: C5\.2\.3\s+Fuel energy flow must not exceed\s+((?:\d{4}\s*(?:MJ/h)?\s*)+)
C5\.2\.7\s+The absolute electrical DC power of the ERS-K may not exceed\s+((?:\d{3}\s*(?:kW)?\s*)+)
(\d{3})\s*kW during any power limited period in Qualifying
C5\.2\.9\s+The difference between the maximum and the minimum state of charge of the ES may not exceed\s+((?:\d(?:\.\d)?\s*(?:MJ)?\s*/?\s*)+)
C5\.2\.3\s+Fuel energy flow must not exceed\s+((?:\d{4}\s*(?:MJ/h)?\s*)+)

C5\.2\.9\s+The difference between the maximum and the minimum state of charge of the ES may not exceed\s+((?:\d(?:\.\d)?\s*(?:MJ)?\s*/?\s*)+)
